dailyNews.name: Daily briefing
dailyNews.prompt: Every morning, gather today's hot topics from 2-3 authoritative tech news sites and pick 5 noteworthy items, each with a one-sentence takeaway and source link. Choose the sources yourself, preferring official blogs and mainstream tech media. Write the result to briefing/YYYY-MM-DD.md, creating the folder if missing; list unreachable sites at the end. Read and write only inside the working directory, and skip any action that needs permission approval.

weeklyIndustry.name: Weekly industry watch
weeklyIndustry.prompt: Research last week's AI industry news, focusing on open-source models, AI products and applications, industry policy and moves of major players. Public sites are fine; choose the sources yourself, preferring official and authoritative media. Write a one-page watch: 3 trend judgments, 3 items worth following (with links) and 1 takeaway for us. Write the result to industry-watch/YYYY-Www.md, creating the folder if missing. Read and write only inside the working directory, and skip any action that needs permission approval.
